summary: Closed several concrete repo-local gaps in the remaining services-listing gate path. This iteration made the shared browse regression deterministic again by restoring Playwright request mocks in `tests/e2e/tasks-services-regression-browse.spec.ts` and switching its assertions to stable route-owned shells instead of translated filter text or page-global first-element selectors. I also brought CI back toward the pinned service bootstrap contract in `.gitlab-ci.yml` by restoring the validator-expected TEST-G3 glob command shape and making `deploy-development` wait on `service-quote-gates` and `service-quote-e2e`, so failing service gates can no longer race ahead of deploy. On the Mobile Safari/browser-hardening side, the public `/tasks` and `/services` client layouts now fail open when Capacitor `Preferences.get(...)` throws, `BottomNavBar.svelte` no longer treats storage-access failures as fatal during initial token detection, and `/tasks` no longer ships the dev-only performance testing helper or double-awaits route translations on mount before the browse shell can paint. `git diff --check` is clean on the files touched in this iteration. The remaining work is now concentrated in finishing a clean post-patch build and rerunning the validator/browser bundles on this final patch set; external GitLab merge-policy verification still remains outside the local shell until CI credentials are available.
remaining_work: Finish a clean `npm run build` on the final patch set, then rerun `npm run test:e2e:validate-service-bootstrap` to confirm the restored CI/bootstrap contract is green.
Rerun `tests/e2e/tasks-services-regression-browse.spec.ts` on Chromium and Mobile Safari against the final patched build to confirm the Mobile Safari browse regression is resolved.
If the targeted browse rerun is green, rerun the full Mobile Safari non-visual aggregate and the final Chromium visual bundle to close the remaining local `TEST-G3` / `TEST-G4` evidence.

If Mobile Safari still fails after the current fail-open/bootstrap cleanup, continue the route-specific hardening pass on the remaining `/tasks` / `/services` startup delta until the cross-browser aggregate is clean.

Verify the remaining external `CI-G1` GitLab merge-policy requirements (`only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds`, required jobs active for merge requests) using `GITLAB_TOKEN`, `CI_API_V4_URL`, and `CI_PROJECT_ID` or the real GitLab CI environment.
